title: Sticker Mule: Software engineer
description_review: Exceptional full-stack engineer building products for an e-commerce and creator software suite, using Go, TypeScript, React, Expo, GraphQL, Postgres on GCP with heavy AI use. Fully remote from 40+ countries; New York headquarters; $150k to $250k USD plus signing bonus.
pros: Full-stack ownership of products end-to-end matches full-stack profile
Aggressive AI usage in daily engineering matches AI-augmented engineering
cons: Go, React Native and GCP stack, no Java or Spring Boot
Product-startup scope rather than enterprise architecture

description_review: Senior independent AI engineer and architect in an invite-only network working on LLM products, agent architectures and orchestration, enterprise AI deployments and ML platforms. Remote across Americas, Europe or Israel. The $200M figure refers to network earnings, not compensation.
pros: Agent architectures, orchestration and enterprise AI deployments match multi-agent and applied GenAI experience
Senior architect scope matches architecture and modernization priorities
cons: Freelance network model rather than an employment role
Java and Spring Boot not mentioned

title: A.Team: Senior Independent Software Developer ($90-$170/hr)

pros: Senior builder building software from scratch matches senior profile
Enterprise client work with autonomy matches enterprise domain
cons: Stack not stated; Java and Spring Boot not mentioned
Freelance project model with variable scope

title: bondex: Fullstack Web3 Engineer (Solidity / Rust / Typescript)

description_review: Director leading an applied AI team building the B2B data graph that AI agents reason over, combining ML, LLM and agentic systems with hands-on coding. US remote and several US offices. Same posting as another ZoomInfo listing in the workspace, listed here under the AI source.
pros: Applied AI and agentic systems ownership matches applied GenAI and multi-agent experience
Hands-on code and architecture decisions match senior engineering profile
cons: Director-level people management is heavier than the profile emphasis
